message: The main reading of sphurat is 'sparkles' (component meaning 'sparkling'). MW supports it (mw-sphur: 'to flash, glitter, gleam, glisten, twinkle, sparkle'). But neither word-by-word source uses that sense. shlokam-vedasara-shiva-stava.md has 'sphurat:spurting' ('spurting out the holy waters'), and gitapress-stotraratnavali.md has 'श्रीगंगाजी खेल रही हैं' ('playing'). Both describe the water moving, not shining. The data does record 'spurting, gushing out' as an alternative, so this is not a fail under README rule 4. However, the rubric excuses disagreement only when the alternatives carry medium/low confidence, and this word is marked 'high'. A human should decide whether to keep 'sparkling' as the main reading.
suggested_fix: Either lower words.w11.confidence to 'medium', or make the movement sense the main reading (e.g. en 'whose Gaṅgā water leaps and quivers', hi 'जिनकी जटाओं में गंगाजल उछलता-थिरकता है') and keep 'sparkling' as the recorded alternative. Change the component meaning (components[0].meaning) to match.
